description_full: T1 Energy Inc. provides energy solutions for solar modules and cells in the United States, Norway and internationally. It manufactures and sells photovoltaic solar modules. The company was formerly known as FREYR Battery, Inc. and changed its name to T1 Energy Inc. in February 2025. T1 Energy Inc. is headquartered in Austin, Texas.

financial_summary: T1 Energy Inc. is a small-cap industrials business with a $572M market cap on $755M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +25573% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are expanding by +2493.2pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.

Returns on capital run at -38% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, and 25% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.
The business throws off $17M in free cash flow — roughly 2 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, thin -13.1× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 14% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
